name: Brainrot Slingshot
desc:
⭐ How FAR can you SLINGSHOT?

💡 How to play:
        💵 Go to the slingshot and throw your brainrot to travel crazy distances!
        📐 Use your money to build the tallest cliff ever and fly further!
        ⭐ Upgrade your BRAINROT to reach incredible speeds!
        😄 Teleport to your friends' bases to have even more fun!
⚡️  Premium benefits: Premium players get 1.5x XP ⚡️
